long_biography.plain_text:
Raised in a Flawil textile family, Ralf Klingler first trained as a sporting-goods salesman, completed a commercial apprenticeship and spent five years with OBT in property administration and brokerage. An early house purchase and resale persuaded him to leave salaried work. Around 1990 he founded VTAG, initially in St Gallen, taking several former clients with him.

Klingler grew VTAG from one employee into one of eastern Switzerland’s substantial property owners and managers. During the mid-1990s downturn, he specialised in buying overleveraged buildings, stabilising them and reselling them profitably. The group later expanded across property management, brokerage, finance and related holdings. He remains on VTAG’s management team and continues to hold numerous board mandates, while the firm operates from Flawil, his birthplace and long-standing business base.
